notes:
Fixed
• Premiere no longer goes "Not Responding" during long edits. Solis now gives Premiere time to catch up: it sends smaller batches, rests between them in proportion to how hard Premiere just worked, and 
• Sounds, music and images are now imported at the start of the edit, while Premiere is idle, one file at a time. Before, they were imported right after thousands of timeline changes, which froze Premie
• An edit stopped by an older version resumes cleanly: Solis imports what it still needs first, then continues where it left off without redoing the cut.
• No saving in the middle of an edit: the project is saved once at the end, and Solis does not wait on Premiere's save dialog.
• "Edit stopped" no longer appears when Premiere is busy or briefly shows another project. Solis waits and continues. If it waits too long, the edit pauses with progress saved; choose Resume Edit.
